implementation_summary: Added ready_for_review as a next-queue trigger so a bottom queued PR that was draft during the previous merge tick can retrigger automerge when it becomes reviewable.
Separated ready_for_review ticks from closed-merge ticks by setting AFTER_PR=0 unless the event action is closed, preventing the ready PR from being treated as already merged and skipped.
Codified oya-pr-review app binding as app_id=-1 in the machine-readable dev branch-protection config and added live drift checks that fail if GitHub re-pins oya-pr-review to a specific app id.

Recorded required_pull_request_reviews=null in the deployable dev protection JSON so re-application cannot recreate the hidden requiresApprovingReviews=true/count=0 blocker; the merge authority remains the required oya-pr-review status/check.
Updated branch-protection apply payload generation to use GitHub checks objects with app_id overrides instead of legacy contexts-only mutation.

known_gaps.reason: There are no open PRs after #162, so the ready_for_review/auto-merge path is locally and live-dry-run verified but not exercised by a fresh queued PR yet.
Live dev branch protection already matches the intended status-check contexts, app binding, and null pull-request-review gate; this slice avoids unnecessary live mutation.

rollback: Revert this ChangeSet to restore closed-only next-queue triggering and contexts-only branch-protection apply behavior.
